Folks — forwarding Alex's note. EdgeOps pushed the pilot out due to an internal launch and infra work. They asked to be moved to nurture and to be re-checked in early Q3.

Questions / suggested approach:
- Small token: offer a 20% pilot credit to keep the conversation warm? (Prospect budget will be tight; credit may reduce friction when they re-engage.)
- Nurture cadence: monthly product digest + targeted webinar invites. Re-touch the week of 2027-07-05.
- CS involvement: should we loop in a solutions engineer for the one-pager architecture note? I can draft it but would prefer a quick SE review.

I want to avoid touching the deal stage down to lead-lost; just move to "nurture/paused" in HubSpot. Thoughts?

-V
